equivalence.scope: complete admitted course payload, not package or unit
equivalence.starter: JavaScript tokens normalized for whitespace, comments, and consistent identifier renaming; a structure fingerprint also ignores cosmetic literal substitutions.
equivalence.fixture: Starter structure and normalized test fixture must both match, retaining operators and control flow so same-concept/different-defect cases do not collide.
equivalence.repair: Normalized repair tokens, controlled wording synonyms, edit signatures, and bounded token similarity detect cosmetic restatement of the same effective change.
equivalence.decision: A protected task fails only when both its material fixture and effective repair match a learner-visible solution in another lesson of the same course payload.
